questions.question: When the Amalekites raided David's town of Ziklag, they killed everyone they found there. True or false?
When David asked the LORD whether to chase the Amalekites who took his family, what did the LORD tell him?

answers.text: Pursue and you will rescue the captives
Stay and rebuild your town first
Wait here and they will come back

questions.question: After David defeated the Amalekites who raided Ziklag, how much of what they had taken did he bring back?
Some of David's men wanted to keep the plunder from the two hundred who stayed behind. What reason did David give for sharing it?

answers.text: The LORD gave it and protected them
The two hundred are his own family
Saul would punish them for it
